## [Visual Analysis of Time-Oriented Data with Tableau]{style="color:  #4682B4; font-size: 38px;"}

In-class exercise 8 uses Tableau to build three time-oriented views. Each view is published to Tableau Public and embedded below. The three views are a control chart, a slopegraph and a trend-and-cycle view.

```{=html}
<script type='module' src='https://public.tableau.com/javascripts/api/tableau.embedding.3.latest.min.js'></script>
```

### Control Chart for Sales by Category

Tableau is used to plot a control chart of sales by category. A control chart tracks a measure over time against a centre line with upper and lower control limits, which helps separate ordinary variation from unusual movements that may need a closer look.

```{=html}
<tableau-viz id='viz-ic08a'
  src='https://public.tableau.com/views/IC_EX08a/ControlChartforSalesbyCategory'
  width='100%' height='700' toolbar='bottom' hide-tabs>
</tableau-viz>
```

The view is published to Tableau Public at [this URL](https://public.tableau.com/app/profile/mark.yee/viz/IC_EX08a/ControlChartforSalesbyCategory).

### Slopegraph

Tableau is used to plot a slopegraph. A slopegraph connects two points in time with a straight line for each category, which makes increases, decreases and changes in rank easy to read at a glance.

```{=html}
<tableau-viz id='viz-ic08b'
  src='https://public.tableau.com/views/IC_EX08b/Slopgraph'
  width='100%' height='700' toolbar='bottom' hide-tabs>
</tableau-viz>
```

The view is published to Tableau Public at [this URL](https://public.tableau.com/app/profile/mark.yee/viz/IC_EX08b/Slopgraph).

### Arrival Trend and Cycle

Tableau is used to plot an arrival trend and cycle view. The view shows how a measure moves over time and how it repeats across a regular cycle such as the months of the year, which exposes both the long-run trend and the seasonal pattern.

```{=html}
<tableau-viz id='viz-ic08c'
  src='https://public.tableau.com/views/IC_EX08c/ArrivalTrendandCycle'
  width='100%' height='700' toolbar='bottom' hide-tabs>
</tableau-viz>
```

The view is published to Tableau Public at [this URL](https://public.tableau.com/app/profile/mark.yee/viz/IC_EX08c/ArrivalTrendandCycle).
